digest.component_or_area: summary computation and agent interface contracts
propositions: summary_compute resolves tickets through show_state but omits the resolved alias from return payload, causing caller-supplied prefixes to remain locally salient
agents preferentially copy four-character ticket prefixes instead of user-friendly aliases because aliases are not exposed in local summary results
summary schema and CLI/library/MCP contracts institutionalize alias-free output shape, preventing alias availability to downstream consumers
adding resolved alias as an additive field to summary results and affirmative agent guidance independently drives alias selection to 25/25 in behavioral evaluation
ambiguous-prefix resolution remains fail-closed and canonical UUID identity semantics are preserved despite alias foregrounding in summaries
